title: Gamma and chi-square inverses use erfinv(p)^2 at a=0.5, Goldstein 451 for a > 1, a 0.9999 complement switch, and damped Halley
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, the five gamma and chi-square inverse functions share one unit solver plus closed forms. At alpha == 0.5 (df == 1), Excel computes erfinv(p)^2 directly using the exact same four-piece rational/AS 241 tables as NORM.S.INV (omitting sqrt(2) on the central pieces and scaling the AS 241 tail by 1/sqrt(2)), flushing subnormal y*y to 0.0 inside the unit helper before multiplying by beta or 2.0. For general shapes, a > 1.0 starts from Goldstein (1973, CACM Algorithm 451) 7-term stored polynomial a * ((c * c) * c) (with z = -NORM.S.INV(q) on right-tail CHIINV/CHISQ.INV.RT for df >= 3 so tiny q never collapses 1 - q to 1.0); a < 1.0 uses AS 91 -1.24 * ln(p) power-law or Wilson-Hilferty with a * exp(3 * ln(c)). Above strict prob > 0.9999 (0x3fefff2e48e8a71e), the Halley residual switches to the upper/lower complement (comp(prob) - flush(Q) or flush(P) - comp(prob)). The unfactored Halley step uses AS 109 thirding damping on sign changes, a 106-trial budget, and stops on |next - x| <= eps * x (returning best_x by strict < on |df| without evaluating next) or |last_adj| >= step_limit && !improved. Remaining >= 5 ULP misses on GAMMA.INV/GAMMAINV sit almost exclusively in a < 1, y < 1.1 where conditioning ~ 1/a magnifies forward gratio offsets. See https://github.com/DnaCalc/DnaCalc/blob/344d70dcea3ea77cbbeee1595f96694630a9610a/docs/articles/last-bit-gamma.md and https://github.com/DnaCalc/DnaCalc/blob/18828c4446e1375dd58ab855ea87c09d649b2e67/docs/articles/last-bit-normsinv.md.
basis: Measured across cb6 (140 of 140 on a==0.5 / df==1 frozen holdout; 291 of 500 overall), nx6 (20 of 20 on a > 20 GAMMA.INV), and nx7 (30 of 30 on |next - x| <= eps*x, 57 of 60 on a*exp(3*ln(c)) + stop rule, 51 of 65 on damping stop). Across the 5 inverse witness banks (20,160 rows before nx9 expansions), nx5..nx7 raised exact matches from 17,712 to 19,430 (CHIINV 4,290/4,293 worst 2 ULP, CHISQ.INV 2,900/2,903 worst 2 ULP, CHISQ.INV.RT 4,190/4,191 worst 2 ULP).
inferred: The internal loop structure and exact stopping predicates are inferred from prospective frozen holdouts and bisection across the 0.9999 and a=1.0 thresholds.
